overall: AG found the Council violated the OML when five of nine councilors (a quorum) deliberated outside a posted meeting to draft a budget/tax statement; reading it at a later open meeting did not cure the violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Council deliberated outside a properly posted meeting to draft a statement on the FY2026 budget and tax implications.
allegations.key_passage: In its response to the complaint, the Council does not deny that a quorum of the Council deliberated outside of a properly posted meeting, and we find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Disclose, within thirty (30) days of the date of the letter, any communications between and among a quorum of the Council concerning the FY2026 budget and tax implications statement.
remedy_passage: In addition, we order the Council to disclose, within thirty (30) days of the date of this letter, any communications that occurred between and among a quorum of the Council concerning the statement about the budget and tax implications for fiscal year 2026.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
